Loomwright Studio · Thread continuity mockup

Reply, Summarize & start fresh with its ⓘ and preview, and Copy reference with its chip, in Wright's Chat and in Sandbox Developer's Crew thread; the size hint in Settings; session names in Sessions and Tasks, with rename in place; and the charter card in plain language in Approvals. Every state in light and dark. Click through, use the keyboard, or force a view from the strip below or the URL hash. Nothing here talks to a real kernel.

Theme
Keys: ⌘K or / palette · ⌘1–⌘6 screens (in a browser tab ⌘ switches tabs first; use ⌃1–⌃6 and ⌃K) · Tab reaches Reply, Summarize & start fresh, its ⓘ and Copy reference on each thread · Esc closes the summary preview or the ⓘ panel, else cancels the Reply strip · ⌘V in the composer pastes a copied reference, in Chat or a Crew thread · ⏎ sends · Rename on a thread: ⏎ saves, Esc cancels and returns focus to Rename. Chat ⌘1, Approvals ⌘3, Sessions ⌘4, Tasks ⌘5, Settings ⌘6; Sandbox Developer from the sidebar. URL hash: #view=<view>&theme=<light|dark|system>.
